No injury designation on final report despite shoulder; said Friday he will play Monday night.
Activated from reserve/PUP Oct 22 after ACL tear; set to make season debut vs KC in a committee with Emanuel Wilson.
Charbonnet's activation cuts into Wilson's workload; Seattle backfield now Charbonnet/Wilson with Holani behind them.
Losing ground in Seattle's backfield; Charbonnet's return pushes him toward RB3/RB4 duty.
